yelp_bright_smiles.name: Bright Smiles Dental
yelp_bright_smiles.address: 450 Sutter St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94108

rev_ybsd_001.text: Dr. Nakamura is wonderful! She joined the practice recently and is incredibly skilled. My cleaning was thorough and painless. Modern equipment and a friendly team.

rev_ybsd_002.text: First visit with the new dentist Dr. Nakamura and I'm impressed. She took time to explain my treatment plan. The office has been recently renovated too.

rev_ybsd_003.text: Dr. Nakamura did my filling and it was quick and painless. She's a great addition to the practice. Modern techniques and great bedside manner.

rev_ybsd_004.text: Good dental office. Dr. Nakamura is competent and gentle. Pricing is still on the higher side but the quality of work is good. Easy online booking.
